purpose: Local unpublished prototype identification using existing artworks, not generated or redrawn. Period corporate/reference crests except explicitly labelled West Ham 2015/16 gold commemorative Boleyn kit variant; not exact kit embroidery or a uniform corporate-mark claim.
rights: Club crests remain copyright/trademark material. Wikimedia non-free-use rationales apply to their specific Wikipedia use, not a licence for Matchmate. Official hosting also grants no blanket reuse permission. No endorsement or publication/commercial-use clearance is asserted; obtain clearance before external distribution.
safety: SVG declarations/editor metadata removed; artwork retained. SVG safety checked at build/test time. Assets render as images, never injected as SVG markup. PNG signatures checked. No runtime remote requests.

assets.historical_status: Supported as the corporate full crest, not the simplified Liver Bird worn on shirts.
